steps.title: Open the Playbook Signals screen
steps.narration: The Playbook surface lets you scan historical sessions for recorded trading patterns. Here we land on the /desk page where all eight signal families are ready to detect.
steps.point_out: The Playbook Signals panel with eight setup types: opening range, continuation, climax, and range families.

steps.title: Show the invalid-date error state with colored border
steps.narration: When you type an invalid date, the input shows an error border in amber and displays a helpful message. This makes it clear what needs to be fixed.
steps.point_out: The date input border turns amber to indicate an error; an error message appears below it.

steps.title: Clear the error with a valid session date
steps.narration: Once you enter a valid date from a recorded session, the border returns to normal. Now you can run the playbook scanner.
steps.point_out: The input border changes back to the default color; the error clears.

steps.title: Run the Playbook scanner
steps.narration: Click Run Playbook to scan that session for all eight signal families. The detector checks opening ranges, continuations, climaxes, and range trades.
steps.point_out: The scanner runs and loads signals found in that session, organized by family.

steps.title: View the signal families detected
steps.narration: The Playbook Signals results show all patterns found: opening-range breaks, JBE continuations, cup-and-handles, climax reversals, and range trades. Each signal includes exact entry prices and invalidation levels.
steps.point_out: The signal table displays detected patterns with their entry prices, invalidation levels, and timing for each pattern type.

steps.title: Review evidence distributions
steps.narration: The Evidence tab shows statistical distributions of how each signal family performed historically. You see the count of signals found and minimum-sample guards for honest reporting. The data is served by read-only tools that proxy the backend securely.
steps.point_out: Distribution data for each setup family with sample counts and performance metrics. The signature badge confirms the data contract is verified.

steps.title: All playbook families working end to end
steps.narration: All eight pre-registered signal families work end to end: opening ranges, JBE, DBI, cup-and-handle, capitulation, euphoria, range trades, and double tops. Evidence is always honestly reported with sample-size guards.
steps.point_out: The complete Playbook Signals surface with all signal families ready to detect and evidence honestly disclosed.
